On Thursday, the market initially gave back some of those gains, as oil prices reversed higher after new developments regarding the conflict in Iran. On Thursday, however, they reversed higher on new developments regarding the conflict in Iran. **Oil** Oil prices fell early in the week as investors grew cautiously optimistic that a resolution to the Iran conflict could be approaching. **Gold** Gold entered the week around $4,530 per ounce and spent most of the first half of the week drifting lower, pressured by rising Treasury yields and growing speculation that a potential resolution to the Iran conflict could reduce safe-haven demand.
